comparison.objective: Remove one tissue while leaving the next tissue presented and the light box in place.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize the box bimanually and pull an interfolded deformable sheet with controlled friction.
comparison.success_condition: First tissue must leave the box and reach the tray, second tissue must remain partly contained and protruding, and the box must finish upright and positioned.
comparison.reason: This tests deformable frictional extraction and presentation of an interfolded follower. It does not test rigid raceway continuity or rolling-element containment.
